prompt: Assemble the dieline into a flawless 3D box with accurate panels, clean folds, undistorted type, and artwork preserved exactly. Shoot it upright at a refined three-quarter angle in a minimal premium studio setting with a soft neutral background, diffused light, subtle shadows, no props, true colours, matte paperboard texture, and realistic editorial detail. The box front reads "AURAE / COLD-BREW MATCHA / 12 fl oz" in clean sans-serif. Side panel shows small ingredient list in 8pt type, nutrition-facts-style block. Clean, editorial, award-winning packshot aesthetic.

promptStructure.subject: 3D product box from dieline
promptStructure.style: 海报排版、商品商业图、图表/信息图
promptStructure.composition: 竖向主视觉，主体层级清楚，保留上下安全区
promptStructure.lighting: 沿用原提示词的光线方向、反差和氛围
promptStructure.materials: 保留关键材质、表面纹理与边缘细节
promptStructure.text: 只保留必要文字，指定层级、位置和可读留白

reuseProfile.label: 可直接改写
reuseProfile.note: 主体和变量替换后即可进入生成验证。

replicationGuide.bestFor: 商品主图、详情页视觉、广告素材、包装展示和社媒种草配图
requiredInputs: 商品名称、外形和核心卖点
目标渠道、画幅与文案安全区
keepFixed: 商品外形、标签位置和关键卖点必须保持
光源方向与接触阴影需要一致
verification: 商品轮廓和包装结构没有变形
材质、反光和接触阴影可信
卖点在手机端仍能看清
逐字检查标题、标签、数字和品牌拼写
failureWatchouts: 参考图约束不足导致换包装或改 Logo
道具过多抢走商品焦点
